newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kerry Stokes seen lowering Austrim stake.
newsitem.headline: Kerry Stokes seen lowering Austrim stake.

text.p: Investment company Austrim Ltd topped the Australian share market's turnover list on Tuesday with a parcel of 13.18 million shares traded, valued at A$36.90 million.

The 9.2 percent stake was traded by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell at A$2.80 each and is the same size as that held by Nerriga Pty Ltd, a privately-held company owned by television network owner Kerry Stokes.
Stokes, the chairman and largest shareholder in Seven Network Ltd, holds another five percent of Austrim through a number of other unlisted companies.
Austrim shares were 15 cents higher at A$2.95 at 12.00 p.m. (0200 GMT).
Austrim's managing director is Alan Jackson, the former chief executive of BTR Plc and its Australian offshoot BTR Nylex.
